name: Aditya Birla Capital Ltd.
business_summary: Holding company for the Aditya Birla Group's financial services: NBFC and housing-finance lending (~58% of value, model est.), life insurance (JV with Sun Life), asset management (ABSLAMC), health insurance and wealth/broking. Q2 FY27 consolidated PAT Rs1,288cr (+38%) on lending growth and cost control; revenue Rs5,493cr in the quarter. Entered the gold-loan business on 2026-08-19. Promoters 68.8%, FIIs 8.3%. Stock Rs399, P/E 29.8x, P/B 3.1x, +20% in 12 months; Jefferies sees ~25% upside while noting rising rates.

exposures.mechanism: Borrowings ~Rs1.3 lakh cr (Q2 interest Rs2,736cr x4 / ~8.3%; model est.), ~45% floating: 25bp = Rs150cr/yr; half re-prices via floating SME/LAP/corporate assets => ~-75cr = -1.5% of lending-business PBT; lending is ~55-60% of group value; persistence 0.5; insurance/AMC unaffected => ~-1.5 incl. multiple (P/E 29.8x).

evidence.note: RBI hiked repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance 'calibrated tightening', first hike in ~4 years (The Hindu 2026-10-07; Business Standard 2026-10-14: near-term cuts off the table)
